title: Indian Air Force Recruitment 2027 – Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027
overview: The Indian Air Force invites applications for the Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027 program. This recruitment is open to unmarried male and female candidates for a four-year engagement period. Selection involves an online test, physical fitness test, and medical examination.
description:
Post Name(s)

Agniveervayu (Intake 02/2027)

Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies is not specified. Vacancies are allocated state-wise and will be utilized for the preparation of the Provisional Select List (PSL).

Pay Scale

Agniveervayu will be provided a monthly package with a fixed yearly increment:

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000 per month
  • 2nd Year: ₹33,000 per month
  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500 per month
  • 4th Year: ₹40,000 per month
  • Terminal Benefit: 'Seva Nidhi' package of approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs (inclusive of interest/contributions) upon completion of 4 years.

Educational Qualification

  • Science Subjects:
    • Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent with Mathematics, Physics, and English with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.
    • OR Three years Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/IT) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.
    • OR Two years Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects (Physics and Mathematics) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.
  • Other than Science Subjects:
    • Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent in any stream with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.
    • OR Two years Vocational Course with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English.

Age Limit

  • Birth Date Range: Candidates must be born between 01 July 2005 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive).
  • Upper Age Limit: 22 years as on the date of enrolment.

Application Fee

Fee Amount: ₹550/- plus 18% GST (Non-refundable).

Selection Process

  1. Phase-I: Online Test (Objective Type).
  2. Phase-II: Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Test-I, and Adaptability Test-II.
  3. Phase-III: Medical Examination.

Exam Pattern

  • Science Subjects: 60 minutes duration; comprises Physics, Mathematics, and English (10+2 CBSE syllabus).
  • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes duration; comprises English (10+2 CBSE syllabus) and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA).
  • Marking Scheme: +1 for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -0.25 for each wrong answer.

Important Dates

Event

Date

Online Registration

06 July 2026 to 26 July 2026

Online Exam

22-23 September 2026

PSL Display

Last week of May 2027

Enrolment List Publication

After 01 June 2027

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official portal at https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
  2. Step-I: Register using personal and contact details to receive User-ID and password via email/SMS.
  3. Step-II: Log in to fill out the application form, upload required documents (photograph, signature, left thumb impression, etc.), and submit.
  4. Pay the application fee via the online payment gateway.
  5. Print the submitted application form for future reference.

Important Notes

  • Eligibility: Only unmarried Indian male and female candidates are eligible.
  • Marital Status: Candidates must not marry during the four-year engagement period.
  • Tattoos: Permanent body tattoos are generally not permitted (exceptions for inner forearms and tribal customs).
  • Status: Candidates are not entitled to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) status after discharge.
  • Travel: No TA/DA is admissible for any stage of the selection process.
  • Retention: The Indian Air Force is not obliged to retain Agniveervayu beyond the four-year period. Up to 25% may be enrolled in the regular cadre based on performance and organizational requirements.
